sections.heading: Cabo airport shuttle: private door-to-door service
paragraphs: Whether you are traveling for a destination wedding, a corporate retreat, or a family vacation, you deserve dependable Cabo airport transportation with no compromises. Our bilingual certified crew takes you directly to Pedregal, Marina, or any resort in Los Cabos.

A private Cabo shuttle from Los Cabos Airport is door-to-door: the driver meets you at SJD and drops you at the hotel lobby or villa gate. This Cabo shuttle does not fill seats or add extra hotel stops.
Book a Cabo shuttle for arrival day and the same vehicle type for departure so the party stays together with luggage.

Our fleet of meticulously maintained SUVs, Sprinter vans, and executive vehicles comes with full insurance coverage, complimentary cold beverages on arrival, and zero hidden fees for toll roads, with curated onboard music by DJANES Cabo. Top-rated private transportation in Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.

A Cabo airport shuttle with Cabo Transportation Concierge is 100% private: one vehicle from SJD Airport to your door. Unlike a shared airport shuttle that waits to fill seats, this Cabo shuttle departs as soon as you clear customs, so a family of four reaches Cabo San Lucas in under an hour.

Our Cabo shuttle covers every zone: the Tourist Corridor, San José del Cabo, the Pacific side, and downtown Cabo San Lucas. A one-way or round-trip Cabo airport shuttle includes a bilingual driver, flight tracking, bottled water, and all tolls.

sections.heading: Private Cabo transfers vs shared airport shuttle
paragraphs: Many first-time visitors debate between a shared shuttle and a private transfer. Here is the honest comparison:
There is no Uber, Lyft, or ride-hailing at SJD Airport. Airport taxis are expensive and unregulated. A pre-booked private transfer is the safest, most reliable way to start your Cabo vacation.
A shared airport van is not a private Cabo shuttle. If you want a Cabo shuttle that leaves when you clear customs, book the private option.
bullets: Shared shuttles are cheaper per person but make multiple hotel stops, adding 30 to 90 minutes. You wait for other passengers and share luggage space.

sections.heading: Taxi vs private Cabo transfers from Los Cabos Airport
paragraphs: Three options leave Los Cabos Airport: a pre-booked private transfer, a shared van, or an airport taxi. Uber and Lyft do not operate at SJD. Private Cabo transfers start at $90 USD (San Jose zone, published starting rate). The booking tool shows the locked price for your vehicle and zone before you pay.

Airport taxis are legal and safe. The fare is a flat zone rate paid at the kiosk outside the terminal, usually 90 to 115 USD to Cabo San Lucas, cash preferred, and the line moves at the speed of the next flight. Shared shuttles look cheaper per seat, then add 30 to 90 minutes of other hotels.

For two or more adults, a private Cabo airport shuttle is usually the better total: fixed price, one stop, bilingual driver, tolls included. Full comparison: Cabo shuttle vs taxi vs private transfer .

sections.heading: Los Cabos airport shuttle to San Jose del Cabo
paragraphs: Los Cabos Airport sits just north of San Jose del Cabo. A private Los Cabos airport shuttle to the hotel zone is usually 10 to 20 minutes after you exit the terminal: the shortest Cabo airport transportation we run. Downtown, the art district, and the San Jose marina are a few minutes farther.

Guests at Nobu, Zadún, JW Marriott, Viceroy, Hyatt Ziva, and Casa Natalia should still pre-book. A curb taxi at Los Cabos Airport is unmetered. A fixed Cabo shuttle rate locks the price before you land. If you are staying in San Jose del Cabo and later going to Cabo San Lucas for dinner, add a separate evening transfer.

Puerto Los Cabos and the East Cape (Costa Palmas, Los Barriles) leave from the same SJD curb but run east instead of west. Tell us the community name so the driver takes the correct gate, not the hotel-zone loop.

sections.heading: SJD Airport to Cabo San Lucas: what to expect
paragraphs: Los Cabos International Airport (SJD), also called Los Cabos Airport or SJD Airport, is about 30 minutes from San José del Cabo and 45 minutes from Cabo San Lucas via the toll highway. After landing, clear customs in Terminal 1 or Terminal 2, collect your luggage, and exit through the main doors. Ignore the timeshare vendors: your Cabo Transportation Concierge driver will be waiting just outside with a sign bearing your name.

The drive follows the scenic Transpeninsular Highway (Highway 1) along the Tourist Corridor, passing stunning views of the Sea of Cortez. Toll road fees are always included: you will never face a surprise charge. Most rides take 35 to 50 minutes depending on traffic and your hotel location.

sections.heading: Cabo Transfers to Tours and Activities
Immigration, customs and bags at Los Cabos Airport
paragraphs: International flights into Los Cabos International Airport (SJD) go through immigration, bag claim, then customs. Terminal 2 handles most U.S. and Canadian arrivals. Terminal 1 is used for some domestic and overflow flights. After you clear, both terminals exit toward the same ground-transportation curb.

Budget 20 to 45 minutes from seatbelt sign-off to the curb on a normal day; longer when several wide-body aircraft land together. We track the SJD flight number, not a clock time, so a delay does not cancel your Cabo airport shuttle. If you arrive at T1, follow the group-exit signs to the same outdoor meeting area. Do not pay anyone inside the hall for a “free shuttle.”

Once outside, walk past the taxi line and timeshare desks to Canopy 3 / Island Bar. The Cabo Transportation Concierge hostess holds an CABO TRANSPORTATION CONCIERGE sign. That is the start of your private Cabo airport transportation. Cabo airport arrival guide has the walking path on video.

The hall after customs at Los Cabos Airport is lined with people offering a “free ride” to your hotel. The ride is the hook for a timeshare presentation that can last hours. They are not airport staff and they are not your Cabo Transportation Concierge driver.

Keep walking. Do not stop to hear the pitch. Do not hand over your voucher or passport. Your Cabo airport shuttle is already paid (or set to pay the driver in cash USD). The driver will not ask you to attend a meeting. If someone says your reservation was cancelled or “upgraded,” that is a sales line: check WhatsApp +52 (624) 000 0000 if you want confirmation.
Taxi drivers outside are a separate issue: they are legal but unmetered. A pre-booked private Cabo transfer is the way to skip both the timeshare gauntlet and a curb negotiation.

Villa kitchens in Diamante, Pedregal, Puerto Los Cabos, and Cabo del Sol are easier if you shop before check-in. We add a grocery stop to the Cabo airport shuttle when you request it at booking. Common stops: Costco (San Jose / El Tezal area depending on route), Walmart, La Comer, and Fresko. Tell us the store; we will not invent a second stop unless you ask.

A grocery stop adds time and needs cargo space. A Suburban or Sprinter is the usual choice so bags and groceries are not stacked on laps. If you only need water and beer, skip the store: complimentary cold drinks are already on the arrival Cabo transfer.

Company booking rules ask you to say if you have extra luggage, golf clubs, boxes, or child seats so we assign the correct vehicle. There is no separate published surcharge list. The fix is a larger SUV or Sprinter, not a surprise fee at the curb.

A standard Suburban handles six passengers plus typical checked bags. Golf groups to Cabo del Sol, Palmilla, Querencia, Diamante, or Quivira should book a Suburban or Sprinter so clubs ride in back, not on seats. Surfboards and fishing rod cases need the same note on the reservation. If you are also doing a grocery stop, say so: cargo fills fast.
Child seats and boosters are complimentary when requested at booking. Give ages so the right seat is in the vehicle before it leaves for Los Cabos Airport.
These are the published rules from our Cabo transportation policies, not marketing language:
WhatsApp +52 (624) 000 0000 is the fastest way to request a change. Online card payments run through Stripe (secure checkout). Cash USD to the driver avoids the 16% tax on the same rate.

A tip is not required and is never added as a line item on Cabo Transportation Concierge invoices. Your quoted Cabo airport transportation rate is the rate. If you want to tip, cash USD to the driver at drop-off is the usual method. Travelers who tip typically leave 10 to 20 percent of that transfer. There is no company minimum and no penalty if you do not tip.

Flight-delay wait time is already covered. Do not tip extra “for the wait” unless you want to. If several drivers work a wedding or group move, tip each vehicle or give the coordinator one envelope and say how to split it.
bullets: • Cancellations must be made 72 hours in advance. After that, no refund.
• Changes are allowed up to 5 hours before the service, per Baja California Sur transportation rules.
• Last-minute changes are not guaranteed; they depend on vehicle availability. A change already made cannot be changed again.
• Departure-flight pickup changes need at least 4 hours notice. Airline arrival delays are tracked automatically at no extra charge.

sections.heading: Cabo transportation: frequently asked questions

faq.question: Where do I meet my driver at SJD Airport?
faq.answer: After claiming your luggage and clearing customs, you will see two doors that lead in the same direction. Keep walking: do not stop for timeshare representatives. Once outside, walk past the taxi drivers and cross the yellow stripes toward the "Island Bar." A Cabo Transportation Concierge hostess holding an "CABO TRANSPORTATION CONCIERGE" sign will be waiting for you in Canopy 3. We track all SJD arrivals in real time: your hostess will be there regardless of any delay. Watch our arrival video guide

faq.question: Do you provide baby seats or child car seats?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide complimentary infant and child car seats upon request. Please specify the number of children and their approximate ages at the time of booking so we can have the correct seat type ready in your vehicle.

faq.question: Do you track flights for delays?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We use real-time flight tracking for every reservation. If your flight is delayed, our driver adjusts automatically at no extra charge. You will never be left waiting or charged a late fee because of an airline delay.

faq.question: What is included in the Private SJD Airport Shuttle price?
faq.answer: Your rate includes a private vehicle exclusively for your party, a bilingual certified driver, real-time flight tracking, complimentary cold water and beer upon arrival, all toll road fees, and full insurance coverage. No hidden fees.

faq.question: How much do Cabo transfers cost?
faq.answer: Private Cabo transfers start at $90 USD. Your final price depends on your destination (Cabo San Lucas, San Jose del Cabo, East Cape, Todos Santos, etc.) and vehicle type (SUV, Sprinter van, or limousine). Use our booking tool for an instant quote.

faq.question: Is your Cabo airport shuttle service private or shared?
faq.answer: Our Cabo airport shuttle is 100% private. Your vehicle is exclusively for you and your group: no shared vans, no waiting for other passengers, no multiple hotel stops. You go directly from SJD Airport to your resort or villa.

faq.question: What is the best way to get from SJD Airport to Cabo San Lucas?
faq.answer: The safest and most comfortable way to get from SJD Airport to Cabo San Lucas is a private airport transfer. Cabo Transportation Concierge offers door-to-door service with certified bilingual drivers, real-time flight tracking, and fixed rates. No Uber is available at SJD: private transfers are the reliable alternative.

faq.question: How long is the drive from SJD Airport to Cabo San Lucas?
faq.answer: The drive from SJD Airport to downtown Cabo San Lucas takes approximately 40 to 50 minutes via the toll highway. Hotels along the Tourist Corridor (Chileno Bay, Montage, Grand Velas) are closer, about 20 to 35 minutes. San José del Cabo hotels are only 10 to 15 minutes from the airport. All toll road fees are included in our rates.

faq.question: Is there Uber at Cabo Airport?
faq.answer: No. Uber, Lyft, and other ride-hailing apps do not operate at SJD Airport or anywhere in Los Cabos. The only transportation options from the airport are pre-booked private transfers, shared shuttle vans, or a taxi from Cabo airport. A pre-booked private transfer with Cabo Transportation Concierge is the safest and most reliable alternative.

faq.question: Can I book transportation to Todos Santos or the East Cape?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We provide private transfers from SJD Airport to Todos Santos, La Paz, Los Barriles, East Cape, and the entire state of Baja California Sur. Popular East Cape destinations include Four Seasons Costa Palmas and Aman Nai. See long distance transfers to Todos Santos and La Paz for times, routes, and a vehicle quote.

faq.question: Do you offer wedding transportation in Cabo?
faq.answer: Yes. We specialize in Cabo wedding transportation for groups of any size. We coordinate multi-vehicle logistics with SUV caravans, Sprinter vans for bridal parties, and limousines for the couple. Whether your venue is in Pedregal, Palmilla, Flora Farms, or a private beachfront villa, we handle every transfer with precision.

faq.question: What vehicles are available for my Cabo transfer?
faq.answer: Our fleet includes Chevrolet Suburban SUVs (up to 6 passengers), full-size passenger vans (up to 10 passengers), Mercedes Sprinter vans (up to 14 passengers), Cadillac Escalade SUVs for premium transfers, and stretch limousines for special occasions. Every vehicle is late-model, fully insured, and equipped with air conditioning.

faq.question: How do I pay for my Cabo airport shuttle?
faq.answer: You have two options: pay online with any major credit or debit card via Stripe (your rate is locked at booking), or pay in cash (USD) directly to your driver upon arrival. Paying in cash avoids the 16% tax, so your total is lower. Either way: no surprises.

faq.question: Can I book a private driver for the day in Cabo?
faq.answer: Yes. Our Private Bilingual Driver service lets you hire a dedicated certified driver for a full day or half day. Explore Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, Todos Santos, or anywhere in Baja California Sur on your own schedule. Your driver waits for you at every stop, perfect for shopping, restaurant hopping, or sightseeing.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy for Cabo airport transportation?
faq.answer: Cancellations must be made 72 hours in advance or no refund is provided. Changes are allowed up to 5 hours before the service. Departure-flight pickup changes need at least 4 hours notice. Full rules: Cabo transportation policies.

faq.question: How much should I tip a Cabo transportation driver?
faq.answer: A tip is not required and is never added automatically. Travelers who tip typically leave 10 to 20 percent of the Cabo transfer in cash USD.

faq.question: Can my Cabo airport shuttle stop at Costco, Walmart or La Comer?
faq.answer: Yes. Add a grocery stop at Costco, Walmart, La Comer, or Fresko when you book your Cabo airport shuttle so we assign a vehicle with cargo space.

faq.question: Do you take extra luggage, golf clubs or surfboards on Cabo transfers?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell us at booking. We assign a Suburban or Sprinter with room for clubs, boards, and extra bags. No separate published surcharge: the correct vehicle is the solution.

faq.question: Can I bring my pet on a Cabo airport transfer?
faq.answer: Yes. Cabo Transportation Concierge is pet friendly at no extra charge. Pets travel in a carrier for the full ride and we accept up to two pets per vehicle. Add the request when you book.

faq.question: Is there a fee for pets on Cabo transportation?
faq.answer: No. There is no additional charge for pets on any Cabo airport transfer or local transportation service in Los Cabos. A carrier is required.
